instructions: What does the customer primarily want us to do? If the customer asks for money back, choose refund even when other problems are mentioned.

descriptions.refund: The customer asks to get money back: a refund, reimbursement, chargeback, credit or compensation.
descriptions.cancel_subscription: The customer wants to cancel, stop, pause or not renew a subscription or plan, or close the account.
descriptions.technical_issue: The product, app or website is malfunctioning: errors, crashes, features not working.
descriptions.shipping_delivery: The status, tracking, delay, location, address or condition of a physical delivery.
descriptions.billing_question: A question or problem about a charge, invoice, price, discount or payment method that does not ask for money back.
descriptions.account_access: Trouble signing in: password, verification code, locked, suspended or hacked account, login email.

items.text: I returned the headphones last week. Please refund the full amount to my card.
Please cancel my subscription before it renews next month.
The app crashes as soon as I open the settings page.
My parcel has been stuck in transit for nine days. Where is it?
I reset my password twice and still cannot sign in.
The lamp I bought does not suit me. I would like a refund, please.
I no longer need the premium plan. Please stop it from renewing.
Your website shows an error whenever I try to upload a file.
The courier says my package was delivered, but it is not at my door.
The verification code never arrives, so I am locked out of my account.
